blindSummary: The facility-use ban under a law effective December 2025 is actually enforced: within 48 hours, state/province troopers checked IDs at women's restrooms in the state/province's capitol and issued criminal-trespass warnings to four trans women with one-year bans from the capitol; the state/province attorney-general has since opened enforcement inquiries against a school district (escalated April 2026), and a university student was formally investigated. The highest absolute toll of killings of trans women in the country (44 recorded 2008-2025; 7.6 per 100k/yr); 66 anti-LGBTQ incidents in 2025 (third-highest nationally). In the worst-law group per the July 2026 assessment. Local risk is well below the country-wide average.
